regions.original:
Vorsicht!
Freilaufender Hund

Wenn Hund kommt,
flach auf den Boden legen
und auf Hilfe warten.
Wenn keine Hilfe kommt -
dann ... Viel Glück !!!
regions.translation:
Caution!
Free-roaming Dog

If a dog comes,
lie flat on the ground
and wait for help.
If no help comes -
then ... Good Luck !!!
regions.breakdown: 'Vorsicht!' means 'Caution!' and is a common warning. 'Freilaufender Hund' translates to 'Free-roaming dog'; 'freilaufend' is a present participle used as an adjective. 'Wenn' (if/when) introduces subordinate clauses. 'flach auf den Boden legen' (lie flat on the ground) uses the verb 'legen' (to lay/put) as an imperative, implying 'lay yourself down'. 'auf Hilfe warten' means 'to wait for help'. 'Viel Glück' means 'Good Luck' and is a common expression.

where_youd_see_it: This sign is commonly found at the entrance of a private property or garden, often as a humorous warning.
cultural_note: This type of sign is typically a humorous exaggeration, playing on the stereotype of guard dogs or overly friendly pets. It's usually not meant to be taken as a serious safety instruction.
